'''Heavy laser cannons''' were a variety of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. The [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]] was equipped with heavy [[Laser/Legends|laser]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]].<ref name="RFT">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040115tank|text=Republic Fighter Tank}}</ref>
